description: Where does this coin stand? ONE call per Binance USDT pair instead of six: last daily close, 7/30/90/365-day returns, relative strength vs BTC and vs ETH with the measured base rate, the F6 trend state vs BTC, ATH/drawdown, SMA200 distance, a `parabolic` state, realized 30d volatility and ATR%, liquidity (volume rank and band), tokenomics ratios from the gem screener (Pro+, CoinGecko ratios only), derivatives (BTC only so far), `price_time_displacement` and a `data_quality` block with a mechanical A/B/C grade — each block carries its own note or definition in the payload. Every source can fail independently — sources_used / sources_unavailable make the basis auditable. Works for any Binance USDT pair, not just BTC/ETH/SOL. `detail: 'full'` adds the raw BTC/ETH benchmark returns behind the relative numbers. Descriptive, no signal. For the strategy-side question ("should I take this entry?") use arena_get_signal_context. [Free tier]

detail.description: 'standard' (default). 'full' adds the raw BTC/ETH benchmark returns used for the relative numbers.
